comparison.objective: Hold an unpowered robot joint on its zero mark and insert a calibration pin; candidate registers and secures two switch endpoints.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterholding an articulated link while aligning and inserting a pin versus sliding a mounted sensor while loosening and retightening screws.
comparison.success_condition: Joint marks and pin bore must align, the pin must seat physically, and the link must remain safely supported; candidate needs two ≤6 mm over-center registrations.
comparison.reason: Both are robot calibration, but the tested mechanics differ: counterheld pin insertion versus feedback-guided slide-and-lock adjustment. Candidate fastener and drift thresholds remain missing.
